summary: Parameters of b64decode: required input string, encoding (default utf-8), and urlsafe (2.19+) for the URL-safe alphabet.
questions: How do I decode URL-safe Base64 in Ansible?
Can b64decode use an encoding other than utf-8?

answer_card.title: b64decode parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (required): Base64 string
- `encoding`: defaults to `utf-8`
- `urlsafe` (default false, 2.19+): use the URL-safe alphabet (`-` and `_` instead of `+` and `/`)
